info.name: Fuel Route API - Recording Demo (click Send)

description.content:
Local API: http://127.0.0.1:8000. No authentication, environment or input edits needed.
Open these requests in numbered order. Click Send on each.
01: Long trip: stops, quantities, purchase cost, starting-fuel value and route comparison.
02: Same trip: meta.routing_api_calls=0 and route_from_cache=true.
03: HTML map: open the response in a browser using the returned map_url; clicking Send fetches HTML.
04: Charlotte: explain fuel + driving time at $50/hour + $5/stop.
05: POST: partial starting tank, known starting price.
06-07: Short trip: no purchases, but starting fuel still has a value; compare default price with $3.25.
08-11: Outside-USA input, insufficient starting fuel, overfull tank and negative starting price.
Tests run automatically after Send; check the Test Results panel.
Station coordinates are city representatives; station detours are not included. $5/stop is a six-minute allowance, not a measured stop duration.
